# Daemon RPC

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @inhuman.tools/harness-contract spec`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The daemon's RPC surface is declared once, as an oRPC contract, in
[`@inhuman.tools/harness-contract`](../../packages/harness-contract). The
daemons implement it, [`@inhuman.tools/harness-client`](../../packages/harness-client)
calls it, and the files here are generated from it:

- [`openrpc.json`](./openrpc.json): OpenRPC 1.3, wire-accurate (JSON-RPC method names, by-name params).
- [`openapi.json`](./openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1, the HTTP projection of the same contract (one POST per method).

## Transport

JSON-RPC 2.0 in WebSocket **text** frames on the unix socket `<root>/daemon.sock`.
Params are always a by-name object. **Binary** frames on the same socket carry
read-only Yjs document sync and are not part of this contract.

The host is chosen by the upgrade path:

| Upgrade | Host |
| --- | --- |
| `/kernel` | KernelDaemon |
| `/project?path=<dir>` | ProjectDaemon (owns no methods) |
| `/session?sessionId=<id>` | SessionDaemon of an existing session |
| `/session?path=<dir>[&sessionId=<id>]` | SessionDaemon, created if absent |

A method a host does not own falls through session, then project, then kernel.
A session socket can therefore call kernel methods; a kernel socket answers a
session method with `-32601`.

## Errors

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-32700` | Parse error |
| `-32600` | Invalid request |
| `-32601` | Method not found |
| `-32602` | Invalid params (the params failed their schema) |
| `-32603` | Internal error, including a method result that fails its own output schema |

A thrown error with an integer `code` keeps that code.

## Parks (UI forms)

A method marked *may park* can answer `{ "form": "ui", "pending": "<id>", "body": "<scheme>" }`
instead of its result; its output is then not validated. The caller answers with
`ui/resolve { pending, kind, ... }` (`kind` is `accept`, `cancel`, `text` with `input`,
`opened` with `url`, or `dismiss`). The reply to `ui/resolve` is the resumed call's
result, or another park form. Closing the socket cancels every park it owns.
In the contract a parking method's output is `result | UiForm`.

## Using the contract from an embedder

```ts
import { createHarnessClient, harnessUpgradePath } from "@inhuman.tools/harness-client";
import { connectUnixSocket } from "@inhuman.tools/harness-client/node";

const transport = await connectUnixSocket({
  socketPath: "<root>/daemon.sock",
  target: { host: "session", sessionId },
});
const client = createHarnessClient({ transport, onPark: (form) => ui.answer(form) });
await client.session.kv.set({ key: "model", value: "m", scope: "session" });
```

In a browser or React Native use `connectWebSocket(url)` from the main entry
(`harnessUpgradePath` builds the path part). Other transports implement the
four-member `Transport` interface.

Cancelling a call with an `AbortSignal` rejects locally; there is no wire
cancel, so the daemon keeps working on it.

## Regenerating

```sh
pnpm --filter @inhuman.tools/harness-contract spec          # write packages/harness-contract/spec/*
pnpm --filter @inhuman.tools/harness-contract spec:check    # exit 1 if stale
```

## Client migration note

The web app (`packages/harness-web-app/src/shell`), the iOS app and the TUI
still call through an untyped `request(method: string, params: unknown)`.
They cannot import `@inhuman.tools/harness` (it depends on the web app) but they
can depend on `harness-contract` and `harness-client`, which depend on neither.
Migrate one call site at a time: replace `request("kv/set", {...})` with
`client.session.kv.set({...})`, or wrap the existing socket in a `Transport`.

## Next step: HTTP for SaaS

The contract is already shaped for HTTP (each procedure has a POST route).
Serving it to remote callers is `implement(contract)` plus oRPC's
`OpenAPIHandler` over the same method bodies the daemons run today, behind the
host's own auth. Not built yet; the JSON-RPC transport remains the only server transport.

## Methods

### Session host

| Wire method | Client path | May park | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kv/set` | `session.kv.set` |  | Write a key in session, project or kernel scope |
| `kv/clear` | `session.kv.clear` |  | Clear a key in session, project or kernel scope |
| `plugin/method` | `session.plugin.method` |  | Call a plugin's own state method |
| `policy/set` | `session.policy.set` |  | Set the session's permission mode |
| `policy/explain` | `session.policy.explain` |  | Explain what would happen to a call right now |
| `policy/overlay` | `session.policy.overlay` |  | Set or clear this session's authorization overlay |
| `policy/config-get` | `session.policy.configGet` |  | Read the authorization layers this session resolves against |
| `connect/adopt` | `session.connect.adopt` | yes | Adopt a connection and make it this session's connection |
| `turn` | `session.turn.send` |  | Submit a prompt as a turn, a steer or a queued prompt |
| `turn/cancel` | `session.turn.cancel` |  | Cancel a running turn by turn id or eval request id |
| `turn/visual` | `session.turn.visual` |  | Read one picture seated on the session's head turn |
| `turn/rewind` | `session.turn.rewind` |  | Rewind the session to before a turn |
| `turn/retry` | `session.turn.retry` |  | Retry the last turn |
| `blob/get` | `session.blob.get` |  | Read one blob the session's document references, by content hash |
| `blob/vacuum` | `session.blob.vacuum` |  | Move the session's large stored text into the blob bucket |
| `compact` | `session.compact` |  | Compact the session's context, optionally around a focus |
| `rename` | `session.rename` |  | Set the session title |
| `eval` | `session.eval` |  | Admit a Scheme program as an unattended eval turn |
| `ask/answer` | `session.ask.answer` |  | Answer the live approval ask |
| `ack/pending` | `session.ack.pending` |  | List calls waiting for an acknowledgement |
| `ack/answer` | `session.ack.answer` |  | Acknowledge or refuse a pending call, optionally remembering the acknowledgement |
| `resident/set` | `session.resident.set` |  | Mark the session resident (kept alive) or not |
| `queue/steer-first` | `session.queue.steerFirst` |  | Promote the first queued prompt to a steer |
| `queue/retract-last` | `session.queue.retractLast` |  | Retract the last queued prompt |
| `agent-calls/list` | `session.agentCalls.list` |  | List agent calls made from this session |
| `agent-calls/inspect` | `session.agentCalls.inspect` |  | Inspect one agent call by request id |
| `agent-calls/cancel` | `session.agentCalls.cancel` |  | Cancel one agent call by request id |
